category.description:
The category of the tag that is created in the process of automatic metadata extraction.
This category is not needed for manual tag creation.

metadataType.description:
This defines the way that the tag is created the two options are MANUAL or AUTOMATIC.
by default {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata.Tag} got the value of MANUAL.
